narrative.overview: Supplied pink manicure photography spans a fixed viewport. Burgundy Georgia headings and Arial supporting text sit on a translucent pale surface. Bulgarian copy and disabled controls form the current static presentation.
keyCharacteristics: Location and brand footer metadata without divider
dos: Retain the supplied image and pink brand.
Preserve disabled controls and the fixed viewport.
Account for final CSS text-size overrides.
donts: Do not add scrolling or interaction to the scoped artifact.
Do not invent hover or focus states for disabled controls.
Do not restore the removed service summary bar or footer divider without a new request.
Do not treat optional static variants as the primary design authority.
